trips.name: Pompeii
trips.geocode_query: Pompei Scavi Archaeological Park, Pompei, Italy
trips.description: Walk the remarkably preserved Roman city buried by Vesuvius in 79 AD, reached by high-speed train from Roma Termini to Naples then the Circumvesuviana (or a standard organized coach tour).

trips.name: Florence
trips.geocode_query: Florence Santa Maria Novella railway station, Florence, Italy
trips.description: Take the high-speed Frecciarossa/Italo (about 1.5 hours each way) to see the Duomo, Uffizi Gallery, Ponte Vecchio and Renaissance old town.

trips.name: Tivoli (Villa d'Este and Hadrian's Villa)
trips.description: A short regional train or bus ride east of Rome brings you to Villa d'Este's fountain gardens and the ruins of Emperor Hadrian's sprawling Roman villa.
